timeout_retry_isolation.retry: candidate max 2 retries (3 attempts) with deterministic parse_failures (≤800 chars FAIL tail + traceback), baseline 0 retries — both enforced in harness.py
timeout_retry_isolation.timeout: per-gate 30s synthetic (gate <1s, never hit), 120s at scale per protocol
timeout_retry_isolation.isolation: per-task worktree (candidate: git worktree add per run-id/tid, tmpdir copy for baseline) from same base SHA 7b9850d; no shared mutable state; full-suite cumulative 6/6 confirms no cross-task leak (F02 pilot + 2A pilot)
